regions.region: upper and middle-left graphical abstract plus abstract text
regions.finding: Generic two-route preparation of optically active chloroalkynols followed by CuCN/Grignard conversion to allenols; retained as a general scheme, not a batch experiment.

regions.region: right-column introduction and lower-right starting-material discussion
regions.finding: Prior-literature routes and broad scope claims were not expanded into experiments; the present-paper racemic starting-material statement is resolved by Scheme 1 on page 2.

unresolved: The graphical abstract contains generic R groups and scope ranges rather than batch-specific structures.

regions.finding: Five racemic 3a-e preparations and six optically active homologation/chlorination stages were extracted independently.
Three 3d resolution/deacetylation/enrichment operations and one 3e kinetic resolution were extracted; product and recovered-material outcomes remain separate.
Four CuBr/Grignard scope rows and the separate catalyst-free trace trial were extracted.
Eleven Cu(I) optimization rows were extracted; entry 7 is cross-linked to Table 3 entry 1, and entry 11 retains the 18% NMR carbometalation side product.

unresolved: Most scheme/table entries omit scale, atmosphere, workup, purification, or yield basis.
The catalyst-free trace trial does not restate temperature, duration, or Grignard loading.

regions.finding: Sixteen racemic scope rows were represented; entry 1 is the same optimized batch as Table 2 entry 7 and was merged, while the remaining fifteen rows stay independent.
Nine enantioenriched scope rows were extracted with input/product ee; entry 4 preserves the source's inability to determine product ee.
The 0.5 mmol result was linked to Table 4 entry 8; the 10 mmol, 71% scale-up was retained as a distinct experiment.
The full (R)-7a typical procedure was merged into Table 4 entry 1, including exact quantities, staged addition, workup, chromatography, mass, yield, and HPLC ee method.

regions.region: conclusion, acknowledgments, SI notice, and references
regions.finding: No additional independent experiment was created; the SI availability statement does not establish an associated SI file.

unresolved: Most Table 3/4 rows omit scale, atmosphere, workup, purification, and yield basis.
Candidate product connectivity and all absolute stereochemical assignments remain unverified.
The scale-up does not state reaction duration or operational workup.
